description: Use this when the user wants rent receipts for HRA (rent receipt format for India) as a print-ready PDF: one receipt per month for a financial year (April to March) or a date range, 2 or 3 per A4 page plus a summary page. Put the user's details into the fields (monthly_rent, tenant_name, landlord_name, property_address, financial_year or from/to, rent_changes, payment_mode); details is only a fallback for pasted text. Handles rent changes, part months by calendar days, amounts in words in the Indian system, Hindi and other Indian scripts, a revenue stamp box for cash above Rs 5,000, and a landlord PAN line when the year's rent is above Rs 1,00,000. Does not compute the HRA exemption or tax and does not take the landlord's PAN. Do not use for rent agreements or for tracking unpaid rent.

details.description: Fallback only: the user's details pasted as text, e.g. "Tenant: Rajesh Kumar; Landlord: Sunita Iyer; Rent: 15000; FY 2025-26; UPI". Prefer the fields above.

financial_year.description: Indian financial year (April to March), e.g. "2025-26" or "FY 2025-26". Default: the current financial year. AY 2026-27 is read as FY 2025-26.

from.description: Optional first month or move-in date, e.g. "2025-04", "June 2025" or "15/06/2025" (day first). A date after the 1st makes a part-month receipt with rent by days.

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent in rupees, e.g. 15000, "Rs 15,000", "₹18.5k" or "1.2 lakh". Required unless rent_changes gives every rent.

payment_day.description: Day of the month printed as the receipt date, e.g. 5 or "last". Default: the first day of each rent period.

payment_mode.description: How rent was paid: "cash", "UPI", "bank transfer", "NEFT", "cheque". Cash above Rs 5,000 gets a revenue stamp box. Default: a blank line to fill in.

property_address.description: Address of the rented property, e.g. "Flat 302, Shanti Apartments, 14 MG Road, Bengaluru 560001".

prorate.description: Charge part months by days (default true). false charges the full month.

receipt_prefix.description: Optional receipt number prefix, e.g. "RR-". Default numbers are per financial year, e.g. 2025-26/01.

from.description: First month at this rent, e.g. "2025-10" or "October 2025".

payment_mode.description: Optional payment mode from that month, e.g. "cash" or "UPI".

rent.description: Monthly rent in rupees from that month, e.g. 16500.

to.description: Optional last month at this rent, e.g. "2026-03".

rent_changes.description: Rent changes inside the period: [{"from":"2025-10","rent":16500}], or text like "16,500 from October 2025" or "Apr-Sep 15000, Oct-Mar 16500". Text with any other number in it is refused; send objects then.

rounding.description: Part-month rent rounding: "rupee" (default, nearest rupee) or "paise".

tenant_name.description: Tenant (employee) name as it should print, any script, e.g. "Rajesh Kumar" or "राजेश कुमार".

to.description: Optional last month or move-out date, e.g. "2026-03" or "10/03/2026". Default: 31 March of the same financial year.

name: generate_rent_receipts
title: Generate rent receipts
